change_summary: Replaced verbose pass-through domain_policy with a compact operational checklist (verification, cancel reasons, refund routing).
reason_for_change: policy_summary.j2 is injected into the system prompt and re-sent on every one of ~28 turns, so its token cost multiplies by turn count. The transcripts show the agent already applies the core rules (two cancel reasons, verification), so the full policy text is more than needed at inference. Distilling to a compact checklist that still encodes the compliance-critical rules preserves task success while cutting per-turn input tokens, lowering mean cost per task.
reason_accepted_or_rejected: accepted: all 2 proxy runs improved mean cost per task within guardrails
hypothesis: The domain_policy passed straight through policy_summary.j2 is verbose; distilling it into a compact operational checklist (verification rules, allowed cancel reasons, refund routing) preserves compliance while cutting the per-turn input token count that is paid on every one of ~28 turns.
